basic_details.job_title: Kumuram Bheem Asifabad District Court Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Kumuram Bheem Asifabad District Court has notified vacancies for the Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class post on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can apply offline by submitting applications in triplicate in the prescribed format, sent by post or in person to the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad on or before 28 October 2026. post_wise_qualification.post_name: Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class

qualification.details: Term of Post: One year from the date of assumption of charge, subject to changes as per Hon’ble High Court directions. Powers stand automatically withdrawn upon attaining 65 years of age. | Educational Qualifications & Experience: Candidates must satisfy any one of the following criteria: | Has held any post in Telangana Higher Judicial Services or State Judicial Services and retired or resigned, OR Has held a post in the Telangana Judicial Ministerial Service not below the rank of Superintendent of District Court or Senior Civil Judge or Junior Civil Judge's Court and has a Law Degree, OR Has held a post of Section Officer and above in the High Court service and has a Law Degree, OR A non-practicing Advocate with a practice at the Bar of not less than five years and who is above 45 years of age, accompanied by a Certificate of voluntary suspension of practice issued by the Bar Council of State of Telangana, OR Any retired Gazetted Officer possessing a Law Degree OR who has passed the Criminal Judicial Test (Full test consisting of Indian Penal Code, Criminal Procedure Code) conducted by the Telangana Public Service Commission and who has exercised Magisterial powers during tenure or service for not less than three years. | Age Limit: Must have at least one year to complete 65 years of age at the date fixed by the Court in the year of recruitment. Suitable retired Judicial Officers shall be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications in triplicate in the prescribed format along with revised attestation forms and a duly stamped (for registered post) self-addressed postal cover must be submitted to the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad on or before 28 October 2026 up to 5.00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Term of Post: One year from the date of assumption of charge, subject to changes as per Hon’ble High Court directions. Powers stand automatically withdrawn upon attaining 65 years of age. Educational Qualifications & Experience: Candidates must satisfy any one of the following criteria: Has held any post in Telangana Higher Judicial Services or State Judicial Services and retired or resigned, OR Has held a post in the Telangana Judicial Ministerial Service not below the rank of Superintendent of District Court or Senior Civil Judge or Junior Civil Judge's Court and has a Law Degree, OR Has held a post of Section Officer and above in the High Court service and has a Law Degree, OR A non-practicing Advocate with a practice at the Bar of not less than five years and who is above 45 years of age, accompanied by a Certificate of voluntary suspension of practice issued by the Bar Council of State of Telangana, OR Any retired Gazetted Officer possessing a Law Degree OR who has passed the Criminal Judicial Test (Full test consisting of Indian Penal Code, Criminal Procedure Code) conducted by the Telangana Public Service Commission and who has exercised Magisterial powers during tenure or service for not less than three years. Age Limit: Must have at least one year to complete 65 years of age at the date fixed by the Court in the year of recruitment. Suitable retired Judicial Officers shall be preferred.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Special Judicial Magistrate position permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The term of the post is one year from the date of assumption of charge, and the terms may be changed as per the directions of the Hon’ble High Court for the State of Telangana. Powers conferred automatically stand withdrawn upon attaining 65 years of age.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid on top of the base remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates are paid a remuneration of Rs. 45,000/- plus Rs. 5,000/- as conveyance allowance per month.

faq.question: Q3. Who is disqualified from applying for this position?
faq.answer: Practicing advocates, members of any State or Local Authority, members of the State Legislature or Parliament, persons dismissed or compulsorily retired for misconduct from government service, persons convicted or facing pending charges for moral turpitude, persons of unsound mind, insolvents, and contractors or businessmen having a subsisting contract with the government are disqualified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the working schedule for these courts?
faq.answer: As per High Court Circular ROC.No.802/SO/97 dated 29.01.1998, Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class Courts function for 05 days in a week from Monday to Friday on working days between 7.30 AM and 10.30 AM.
